articles.description: This blog post is based on the work BaNEL: Exploration Posteriors for Generative Modeling Using Only Negative Rewards. A standard recipe involves: (1) pre-training models on existing data to obtain base models, and then (2) post-training them using scalar reward signals that measure the quality or correctness of the generated samples. We explore the following hypothesis both conceptually and, to a small extent, empirically. We call this the Alignment Drift Hypothesis:
